evidence.claim: Volexity recovered a masquerading packet sniffer and its credential-parsing companion script after compromise of an Ivanti Connect Secure appliance. Its October 29 update identifies CVE-2026-111357 as the privilege-escalation stage.
evidence.location: October 29 update, LDAP Packet Capture, and Ivanti Memory Analysis with Volexity Volcano
